grades.quote: lr.w t0, (a0)        # Load original value. bne t0, a1, fail     # Doesn't match, so fail. sc.w t0, a2, (a0)    # Try to update. bnez t0, cas         # Retry if store-conditional failed.
grades.reason: Directly demonstrates the RISC-V LR/SC analogue, including retry when the conditional store fails.
Discusses database transaction isolation, not RISC-V atomic instructions or exclusive-load/store equivalents.
